versions.description_html:
Discover what Microsoft Viva Insights actually is, how the four data views work, and what managers, leaders, and analysts see regarding your productivity.

Microsoft Viva Insights is probably already switched on inside your Microsoft 365 account. You might think it's a tool for your manager to watch you, but the first view it opens is the one that's just for you.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Viva Insights Actually Is
  • The Four Views of the Same Data
  • Your Own Insights: Focus Time, Quiet Time, and Switching Off
  • What Your Manager Sees
  • What Leaders See Across the Company
  • The Analyst Role: Where the Real Questions Get Answered
  • Privacy: What Viva Insights Can and Cannot See
  • What Teams Actually Do With It
  • Recap and One Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
